description: D1 - per-step capacity test. One conv block per step instead of three.
E2 - spatially local InfoNCE, locality annealed along depth.
Structural alternative - masked latent prediction with a depth-scaled mask ratio.
LAST - supervision density test. Loss applied ONLY at the terminal step.
V0 - architecture only. No EMA target, no gradient surgery.
V1 - EMA target only (stationary contrastive targets).
V2 - causal PCGrad only (projected-away conflicting step gradients).
V3 - EMA target + causal PCGrad (the hypothesized best).
